editorial:
Imagine sitting down for a movie and getting twenty-six different scary stories instead of just one long plot. That is exactly what you get here. It is like a huge party of new filmmakers from the UK who all wanted to show off their best creepy ideas. You will see everything from weird monsters and ghostly figures to people just losing their minds. The vibe is very fast and chaotic, so if you have a short attention span, you will love how it jumps from one nightmare to the next without wasting any time.

Some of the acting is a bit stiff since these are new directors, but the twists in the stories make up for it. You will find some shorts that are totally cheesy and others that actually give you chills. If you enjoy a variety of scares, you should definitely give this a try. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection so you can pause and talk about the weirdest parts with your friends. It is a great choice for a late-night movie marathon with snacks.
endingExplained: Since this is a collection of short stories, there is no single main character to follow. Instead, each little movie ends with its own shock. Most of the tales wrap up with a dark twist where the bad guy wins or the character realizes they are already dead. By the time the final short ends, the movie simply closes the book on these nightmarish loops, leaving you to wonder which story was the most twisted.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves short scary stories and quick twists.
